_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 2.2 px cores fused central Bangkok into white at 8:01 (whiteout 0.049); 1.2 px keeps the corridors apart, 0.021
_why.day.BUS_HALO_R: 8 px halos added up to white along every arterial; 4 px leaves dark gaps and lets the group colours show
_why.rush.BUS_CORE_R: 1.2 px cores strobed 0.0044, over the 0.004 limit, on the close-up; 1.0 px gives 0.0035 and still reads as dots
_why.rush.BUS_HALO_R: 8 px halos hid the trail colours on the close-up; at 4 px BMTA, vans and boats read by colour
_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 18 min cuts strobe 0.0038 to 0.0035 for whiteout +0.0002; the arterials stay separate thin lines
_why.TRAIL_SHOULDER_W: 8 px shoulders take the haze off the dense central arterials in the round trip; strobe 0.0035 either way
_why.rush.FRAME_ZOOM: 0.9 shows more of the city around the core and lifts safe share 0.81 to 0.84; 1.1 crops the core at the left
_why.rush.FRAME_DX_KM: -3.77 km brings the Rattanakosin core in from the left edge to the band's centre; safe share 0.849
_why.rush.FRAME_DY_KM: -3.77 km lifts the core and the river bend up from the clock; safe share 0.852 clears the 0.85 limit
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: 14 min cuts the close-up's strobe to 0.0044 (from 0.0052 at 6); corridors stay thin separate lines, whiteout 0.012
_why.week.BUS_HALO_ALPHA: 0.06 halos calm the week: strobe 0.0023 to 0.0008, whiteout 0.001, the group colours read; motion stays 0.30

groups.label: Minibuses
groups.source: chosen: calm green. The soi minibuses and songthaews have no operator brand; OTP's City Mini Bus colour 20B2AA would draw #53d5cd, 0.040 from the city line. Source step: trail #6dd982, line #299446.

groups.label: Boats
groups.source: chosen: FFCC00 is namtang's route_color on the Chao Phraya Express yellow flag (183, 2715), 1 boat at 08:01. Most boats then are the Saen Saep boats (74 of 151, CC00CC, the vans' magenta) and the cross-river ferries (35, 0000FF), so no single brand stands for them. Source step: trail #e6b800, line #997900.
